name: @slopmax/ui
description: The web dashboard, a React app over the daemon's HttpApi

//.@effect/atom-react: React hooks over effect/reactivity atoms: the report, settings and history are atoms fed by the API client and the event stream.
//.@base-ui/react: Accessible headless primitives (menus, dialogs, switches, tooltips, toasts) under the shadcn/ui components in src/components/ui.
//.@fontsource-variable/geist: Geist, shadcn/ui's font: one variable file, Latin subset, shipped beside the CSS by build.ts so the page's CSP never sees it inlined (OFL).
//.cn: shadcn/ui's class helper (clsx and tailwind-merge compiled into one), behind src/lib/utils.ts as components.json expects.
//.class-variance-authority: Typed component variants (cva), so a misspelled variant is a type error.
//.lucide-react: The icon set; each icon is a tree-shaken component.
//.recharts: The charts under shadcn/ui's Chart (src/components/ui/chart.tsx); the version shadcn's chart targets.
//.sonner: The toasts, as shadcn/ui's Sonner. It inserts one <style> at load, which the daemon's CSP allows by hash (test/csp.test.ts keeps the hash honest).
//.tw-animate-css: The enter and exit animations shadcn/ui's components use (animate-in, fade-in, zoom-in-95, …), imported by src/index.css.
//.@happy-dom/global-registrator: Puts happy-dom's window on globalThis for component tests under bun test.
//.@tailwindcss/node: Tailwind's compiler, driven by build.ts's small Bun plugin (the published Bun plugin vendors an older Tailwind).
//.@tailwindcss/oxide: Tailwind's class scanner, for the same plugin.
//.happy-dom: A light DOM for component tests.
//.shadcn: The shadcn/ui CLI (bunx shadcn add …, see components.json) and its shadcn/tailwind.css, which src/index.css imports at build time.
//.size: Measured 2026-11-16 (bun build.ts) after the move to shadcn/ui: app.js 1,309 KB minified, 347 KB brotli, 413 KB gzip (recharts is most of the 473 KB added since 2026-10-31); CSS 120 KB, 15 KB brotli (shadcn/tailwind.css and tw-animate-css); Geist 29 KB. About 391 KB crosses the wire with brotli, up from 310 KB; the daemon's embedded copy sends gzip and the system font, about 431 KB.
